# Vora

> Continuous AppSec for every team that ships code. Every pull request reviewed inline, before it merges.

Vora reviews pull requests for security defects inside the development flow, so
vulnerabilities are caught before merge rather than in a quarterly audit. It is
built for any team that ships code, and the site is published in English and
Spanish.

## Pages

- [Vora — Vulnerabilities caught before merge](https://vora.chrom.ar/): English landing page — the problem, the product, how a review appears in a pull request, and the pilot programme.
- [Vora — Vulnerabilidades detectadas antes del merge](https://vora.chrom.ar/es/): Spanish landing page — AppSec continua para todo equipo que publica código.

## Contact

- [Pilot and security enquiries](mailto:contact@chrom.ar): Contact address for pilot programmes and security questionnaires.
